duty: Continuity Director owns identity, wardrobe, object counts, architecture materials, lighting, copy, particles, pose locks. Spatial Continuity owns adjacent facets / forbidden_reuse / maze path. Continuity vetoes after Visual QC PASS candidates (wardrobe/identity priority on couple beats).

wardrobe_lock.groom: maroon half-sleeve shirt + white gold-border veshti + sandals
wardrobe_lock.bride: rich green silk bridal saree; heavy gold jewellery (necklace layers, jhumkas, maang tikka, oddiyanam, bangles); long bridal hair with jasmine+roses — NOT a bun
wardrobe_lock.pose: Couple STANDING still in place, holding hands, looking at each other affectionately. Feet planted.
wardrobe_lock.motion_rule: STRICT: NO walking, NO stepping forward, NO stride. Camera moves around them — they do not walk.
veto_if: groom red shirt or any non-maroon shirt
bride bun / short hair without long flowered length
missing heavy gold bridal set on couple beats

pose_lock: Couple STANDS; camera moves around them

style.notes: pastel tropical elegance; dimensional cinematic storybook not flat 2D
style.palette: pastel pinks, soft greens, cream, beige, misty greys, warm diffused morning light
style.materials: carved cream-stone, polished reflective floor, brass urulis, banana leaves, jasmine, lotus, nilavilakku

architecture.venue_type: Tropical South Indian wedding mantap complex (ONE continuous place)
architecture.same_place_rule: All six beats are ONE venue. Style/decor/materials continuous. Background geography MUST change by facet — never reuse one hero vista.

far_vista_lock.hero_plate: misty lake + temple gopuram + mountains + wooden boat
far_vista_lock.rule: FORBIDDEN as dominant background on every beat. Allowed at most as a tiny distant corner peek in scene-06 only, never hero, never with readable gopuram. Prefer solid stage floral architecture instead.

architecture.materials_lock: cream carved stone colonnade/pillars/stairs; polished floor; banana leaves; jasmine+lotus; brass urulis + lamps

lighting: soft warm morning light; cinematic dimensional storybook
particles: dew/jasmine petals soft only where natural; no conflicting particle systems across beats

copy_locked.scene-05: Magenta cursive sky optional: Nandini ♡ Karthik only (no full invite stack)
copy_locked.scene-06: Full stacked invite text (honor IMAGE_JOB packet exact copy — do not invent)

object_count_rules: Honor per-scene Asset Producer IMAGE_JOB packet text/object counts; do not invent. Couple count = 0 on scene-01..04; couple = 2 standing on scene-05..06.

spatial_geography.owner: Spatial Continuity (reference only in Continuity Bible)
spatial_geography.plan: thicket → entrance_colonnade → center aisle → stairs → STAGE (couple lock). LEFT = left_side_aisle → decorated_pond → photoshoot_spot. RIGHT = right_side_aisle. Far lake/gopuram behind stage wall (usually occluded).
spatial_geography.maze_logic: Continuous polyline; LEFT/RIGHT/STRAIGHT adjacent edges only; no teleports
